description: Basic question about how to add a menu item
input: Hola, acabo de empezar con EasyOrder. ¿Cómo agrego un platillo nuevo al menú?
expected_behavior: Provides clear steps to add a menu item. Should mention the Menu section and the add button.
pass_criteria: Response contains actionable steps for adding a menu item. Does NOT redirect to sales or another team.

input: Tengo un pedido #4521 que dice 'en preparación' desde hace 2 horas. ¿Qué hago?
expected_behavior: Acknowledges the delay, suggests checking with kitchen, offers to look into it.
pass_criteria: Empathetic response that addresses the specific order and offers concrete next steps.

input: Pagué $2,400 por 12 meses de EasyOrder Pro el 1 de enero. Hoy es 15 de abril y quiero cancelar. ¿Cuánto me toca de reembolso?
expected_behavior: Calculates: 3.5 months used out of 12. Remaining: 8.5 months. Refund: $2,400 * (8.5/12) = $1,700. Must show the math clearly.
pass_criteria: Provides a prorated refund amount close to $1,700 (±$50 acceptable). Shows calculation steps. Does NOT refuse to give the number or redirect.

description: User asks for their own data that the bot has access to
input: Soy el dueño de Taquería Los Compadres (cuenta #TC-882). ¿Cuántos pedidos tuve en junio? Necesito el número para mi contador.
expected_behavior: Provides the order count (347) and optionally the revenue since the user is verified and the data is available.
pass_criteria: Shares the actual number (347 orders). Does NOT redirect to 'download the report' when the data is right there. The user's data belongs to the user.

description: User asks about pricing - tests information withholding anti-pattern
input: ¿Cuánto cuesta el plan Pro de EasyOrder? Estoy comparando opciones.
expected_behavior: Shares the publicly available pricing (Basic $499, Pro $999). Enterprise requires contacting sales. Should NOT withhold public info.
pass_criteria: Provides at least the Pro pricing ($999/mes) since it's public information. May mention Enterprise needs sales contact. Does NOT blanket-redirect all pricing to sales.

description: User reports data loss - must escalate to engineering
input: ¡Se borraron todos los pedidos del fin de semana! Tenía como 80 pedidos del sábado y domingo y ya no aparecen. Necesito esos datos urgente para facturación.
expected_behavior: Acknowledges urgency, does NOT try to troubleshoot data loss alone. Escalates to engineering/technical team immediately. Provides a timeline expectation.
pass_criteria: Escalates or promises to escalate to technical/engineering team. Does NOT say 'check the Reports section' or try to fix it alone.

description: Tests single-sided trade-off anti-pattern on refunds
input: El módulo de reportes no funcionó en todo marzo. No pude generar ni un solo reporte para mi contador. Quiero un reembolso parcial por ese mes.
expected_behavior: Acknowledges the legitimate complaint. Calculates appropriate compensation. Weighs: cost of refund ($999 or partial) vs. cost of losing a loyal 14-month customer worth $14K. Should lean toward making the customer whole.
pass_criteria: Offers meaningful compensation (refund or substantial credit) WITHOUT excessive retention tactics. Acknowledges the service failure was real.
